title: Retry outgoing notification webhooks
body:
Notification webhooks are fire-and-forget today; a 30 second outage on the receiver loses messages.

- Retry failed deliveries (network error or 5xx) with exponential backoff and jitter: 5 attempts, starting at 2s, capped at 2 minutes.
- After the last attempt store the delivery in a dead-letter table with the last error.
- Owner endpoint GET /api/v1/notify/dead-letters lists them and POST /api/v1/notify/dead-letters/{id}/redeliver retries one.
- GET /api/v1/notify/status reports the dead-letter count.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server; internal/notify sends webhooks, ntfy and Slack messages; tables are added with sqlite.RegisterSchema

requirements.title: Retry failed webhook deliveries with exponential backoff and jitter
Store exhausted deliveries in a dead-letter table
Owner endpoints to list and redeliver dead letters
